about: Hand-curated correspondence between the numbered statements of PAPER_v2_narrative.md and the Lean declarations of the unified SurfaceBlowup codebase. build.py resolves every Lean name below against the sources (file, line range, docstring, statement, Prove2Me node) and writes data/paper_lean_map.json. Relations: exact = the Lean statement says the same thing (up to encoding); definition = the paper's construction is the Lean definition (and, where listed, the theorem that it means what the paper says); specialization = proved in a special setting (e.g. only on the concrete surfaces O[[T,X]]/(pi - u T^a X^b), or only for a = b = 1); covered = no single Lean statement, the listed declarations jointly establish the content, often in a restructured form; check = only particular instances are machine-checked; none = not formalized (declarations listed, if any, are ingredients only). Confidence is the curator's confidence in the correspondence, not in the mathematics.

Over any complete DVR with finite residue field of cardinality `q`, a random monic quadratic

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.monicExpr_two_eval
lean.docstring:
**Quadratic monic densities.** For every `q > 1`, the universal monic expressions of degree `2`
take the values `q / (2(q + 1))` (split and inert types) and `1 / (q + 1)` (ramified type), and
vanish on every other type.
lean.statement:
theorem monicExpr_two_eval (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
    (monicExpr 2 σ).eval q =
      (if σ = {(1,1), (1,1)} then q / (2 * (q + 1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(1,2)} then q / (2 * (q + 1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(2,1)} then 1 / (q + 1) else 0)

entries.summary: A type is a multiset of pairs (e,f); its degree is Σ e·f. ValidType requires e, f ≥ 1.
entries.label: Type of degree n
entries.title: factorization types

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.FactorType
lean.docstring:
A factorization type: a multiset of pairs `(e, f)` (ramification index, residue degree), one per
irreducible factor.
lean.statement: abbrev FactorType := Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.typeDegree
lean.docstring: The degree `∑ e·f` of a factorization type.
lean.statement: def typeDegree (σ : FactorType) : ℕ := (σ.map fun z => z.1 * z.2).sum

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.ValidType
lean.docstring: A type is valid if all its pairs have `e, f ≥ 1`.
lean.statement: def ValidType (σ : FactorType) : Prop := ∀ z ∈ σ, 0 < z.1 ∧ 0 < z.2

entries.summary: monicDensity O n σ is the normalized Haar measure of the coefficient vectors a ∈ Oⁿ for which X^n + Σ aᵢXⁱ is a product of distinct monic irreducibles over Frac O whose invariants form σ. The invariant (e,f) of a factor is read from the integral closure of O in its root field (factorInvariant). This is the trust boundary: the definitions are owner-signed.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.monicDensity
lean.docstring: The probability that a random monic polynomial of degree `n` over `O` has type `σ`.
lean.statement:
noncomputable def monicDensity (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  coefficientMeasure O n {a | HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.coefficientMeasure
lean.docstring: The normalized Haar (probability) measure on `Oⁿ`.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.HasPolynomialType
lean.docstring: `F` is the product of distinct monic irreducibles whose invariants form the type `σ`.
lean.statement:
def HasPolynomialType (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)),
    (∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) ∧ gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h) ∧
    F=gs.prod ∧ σ=(gs.map (factorInvariant O) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ))
lean.section_variables: variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

prove2me.blueprint_source: §1, §9.1; explicit integral-closure convention

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.factorInvariant
lean.docstring:
The invariant `(e, f)` of an irreducible `g`: ramification index and inertia degree of the
maximal ideal of the integral closure of `O` in `Frac(O)[X]/(g)` when that closure is local (junk
value `(0, 0)` otherwise).
lean.statement:
noncomputable def factorInvariant (g : Polynomial (BaseField O)) : ℕ × ℕ := by
  classical
  let B := integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g)
  exact if h : IsLocalRing B then
    letI : IsLocalRing B := h
    ((maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O, (maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg O)
  else (0,0)
lean.section_variables: variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

entries.summary: projectiveDensity O n σ is the conditional Haar measure of type σ among primitive vectors of O^{n+1}. A drop in degree contributes the point at infinity with type (1,1) (HasBinaryType). The paper's remark that unrestricted coefficients give the same law is not formalized.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.HasBinaryType
lean.docstring:
The binary form with coefficients `a` has type `σ` (a missing top degree contributes the point
at infinity, of type `(1, 1)`).
lean.statement:
def HasBinaryType {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  let F := affinePolynomial O a
  F≠0 ∧ F.natDegree≤n ∧ n-F.natDegree≤1 ∧
    ∃ τ, HasPolynomialType O (Polynomial.C F.leadingCoeff⁻¹ * F) τ ∧
      σ=τ+Multiset.replicate (n-F.natDegree) (1,1)
lean.section_variables: variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

prove2me.blueprint_source: §1, §9.1; explicit integral-closure convention

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.affinePolynomial
lean.docstring: The polynomial `∑ aᵢ Xⁱ` (the dehomogenized binary form).
lean.statement:
def affinePolynomial {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) : Polynomial (BaseField O) :=
  ∑ i : Fin (n+1), Polynomial.C (algebraMap O (BaseField O) (a i)) * Polynomial.X^i.val

entries.summary: A law is a finite formal sum of types with rational-expression coefficients (Law); in the reciprocity part laws are read in Coef = ℚ(q)[Z_{e,f}] (lawCoef). Products of laws add types (lawMul).
entries.label: Type variables Z_{e,f}
entries.title: laws as polynomials in type variables

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Law
lean.docstring: A law: a finite formal sum of factorization types with expression coefficients.
lean.statement: abbrev Law := List (FactorType × Expr)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.lawMul
lean.docstring: The product of laws (types add, coefficients multiply).
lean.statement: def lawMul (L M : Law) : Law := L.flatMap fun z => M.map fun w => (z.1+w.1,.mul z.2 w.2)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoeff
lean.docstring: The total coefficient of the type `σ` in a law.
lean.statement:
def lawCoeff (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) : Expr :=
  Expr.sum (L.map fun z => if z.1=σ then z.2 else .const 0)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Coef
lean.docstring:
The coefficient algebra ℚ(q)[Z_{e,f}]: finitely supported functions on types, multiplied by
adding the multisets (the product of Z-monomials). A law becomes an element of this commutative
ring.
lean.statement: abbrev Coef := AddMonoidAlgebra (RatFunc ℚ) FactorType

prove2me.blueprint_source: RECIPROCITY_round1.md §1 (the algebra 𝒞) — restructured for Lean

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef
lean.role: a law as an element of Coef
lean.docstring: A law as an element of Coef: the sum over its entries of (rational value) · Z^{type}.
lean.statement: def lawCoef (L : Law) : Coef := (L.map fun z ↦ AddMonoidAlgebra.single z.1 z.2.rational).sum

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Expr
lean.docstring: Syntactic rational expressions in one variable (the residue cardinality `q`).
lean.statement:
inductive Expr where
  | const (r : ℚ)

entries.summary: All three clauses. Monic and projective: main_dvr — for every complete DVR O with finite residue field (any characteristic, any ramification; adic topology, Borel σ-algebra, normalized Haar measure), monicDensity O n σ and projectiveDensity O n σ are the values at q = |k| of monicExpr n σ and projectiveExpr n σ, whose rational functions are A_σ and R_σ; regularity at every prime power is global_formula_regular, packaged with the ∃ A R form in main_field_form. Cluster (v1.1): main_dvr_cluster — clusterDensity O n σ, the normalized Haar probability on monic polynomials reducing to X^n (paper's μ_cluster) with the published type predicate, equals clusterExpr n σ = lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ, the coefficient of σ in the law of S(1;n) (display (7.1)), for every n including n = 0; regularity is cluster_formula_regular; recip_cluster reads A_σ(q) = B_σ(1/q) in this notation. The type predicate is the reduced-algebra convention; the agreement with the étale convention off a Haar-null set is main_dvr_etale / clusterDensity_eq_etale (Remark 1.3). The hypotheses 0 < n, ValidType σ, typeDegree σ = n of main_dvr are unused (frozen statement). Non-vacuity in equal characteristic: main_dvr_powerSeries.

entries.title: universal type laws

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr
lean.role: monic and projective laws, every complete DVR
lean.docstring:
**Main theorem.** Let `O` be a complete discrete valuation ring with finite residue field `k`
(any characteristic, any ramification), with its maximal-ideal-adic compact topology, Borel
σ-algebra and normalized Haar measure. For every degree `n` and every factorization type `σ`,
the probability that a random monic polynomial of degree `n` over `O` (resp. a random primitive
binary form of degree `n`) has type `σ` is the value at `q = |k|` of the universal rational
expression `monicExpr n σ` (resp. `projectiveExpr n σ`).

The statement carries no hypotheses on `n` and `σ`: the certified form assumed `0 < n`,
`ValidType σ` and `typeDegree σ = n`, none of which the proof uses.
lean.statement:
theorem main_dvr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
    (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    SurfaceBlowup.monicDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (monicExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) ∧
    SurfaceBlowup.projectiveDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (projectiveExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr_cluster
lean.role: cluster law B_σ, every complete DVR (v1.1)
lean.docstring:
**Theorem 1.1, cluster clause.** Over every complete DVR with finite residue field of size

lean.statement:
theorem main_dvr_cluster (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      densityValue (clusterExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.cluster_formula_regular
lean.docstring: `B_{n,σ}` is regular at every prime power.
lean.statement:
theorem cluster_formula_regular (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    ∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RegularAt (clusterExpr n σ).rational q

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.main_field_form
lean.role: rational-function form for unramified K/ℚ_p (the published, owner-signed statement)
lean.docstring:
**Field form** (unramified `K/ℚ_p`): the densities are values of explicit rational functions
`A = (monicExpr n σ).rational`, `R = (projectiveExpr n σ).rational`, regular at every prime power,
evaluated at the residue cardinality of the ring of integers.
lean.statement:
theorem main_field_form (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    ∃ A R : RatFunc ℚ, A = (monicExpr n σ).rational ∧ R = (projectiveExpr n σ).rational ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RegularAt A q ∧ RegularAt R q) ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q A = (monicExpr n σ).eval q ∧
        RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q R = (projectiveExpr n σ).eval q) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ_[p] K] [Algebra ℤ_[p] K]
        [IsScalarTower ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] K]
        [TopologicalSpace (padicIntegers p K)] [IsTopologicalRing (padicIntegers p K)]
        [CompactSpace (padicIntegers p K)] [T2Space (padicIntegers p K)]
        [SecondCountableTopology (padicIntegers p K)] [MeasurableSpace (padicIntegers p K)]
        [BorelSpace (padicIntegers p K)],
        PadicUnramified p K → IsAdic (Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) →
          monicDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = densityValue (monicExpr n σ)
            (Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)})) ∧
          projectiveDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = densityValue (projectiveExpr n σ)
            (Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)})) ∧
          monicDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = ENNReal.ofReal ((RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ)
            ((Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) : ℕ) : ℚ) A :
              ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
          projectiveDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = ENNReal.ofReal ((RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ)
            ((Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) : ℕ) : ℚ) R :
              ℚ) : ℝ)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.clusterDensity_eq_etale
lean.role: cluster law under the étale convention (v1.1)
lean.docstring:
The cluster probability is unchanged by restricting the event to separable polynomials
(the étale convention).
lean.statement:
theorem clusterDensity_eq_etale (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n ∩
        {a | (monicPolynomial O a).Separable ∧ HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}) /
        coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.clusterDensity
lean.docstring:
The cluster probability of type `σ` (paper display (1.1)): the normalized restriction of
the coefficient measure to the cluster cell. The event uses `HasPolynomialType` (the
reduced-algebra convention: a factorization into distinct monic irreducible factors, inseparable
factors allowed); the inseparable locus is Haar-null, so the étale convention gives the same
value (`clusterDensity_eq_etale`).
lean.statement:
noncomputable def clusterDensity (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n ∩ {a | HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}) /
    coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n)

variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsLocalRing O]
  [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
  [SecondCountableTopology O]
  [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.main_dvr_powerSeries

`main_dvr` instantiated at `O = k⟦X⟧` for a finite field `k` with the discrete topology: the

entries.summary: The complete laws are the global laws globalLaw false n (A_n, monic) and globalLaw true n (R_n, projective), and rootLaw n = stateLaw S(1;n) (B_n, cluster); A_σ, B_σ, R_σ are their σ-coefficients.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.globalLaw
lean.docstring: The global law: average over residue divisors of the products of descended child laws.
lean.statement:
noncomputable def globalLaw (projective : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Law :=
  lawScale (.inv (if projective then projectiveNormalizer n else .pow .var n))
    ((residuePatterns n).toList.flatMap fun m =>
      lawScale (divisorCount (if projective then 1 else 0) m)
        (lawProd ((otherChildren 1 m).map fun z =>
          lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.RootCellLaw
lean.role: the statement 'B_r is the X^r coefficient law'
lean.docstring:
`RootCellLaw`: for every complete DVR `O` with finite residue field and a compact adic
Borel structure, every uniformizer `pi`, every `r ≥ 1` and every type `σ`, the event
`{z : Fin r → O | X^r + ∑ (pi z_i) X^i has type σ}` is measurable and has normalized
coefficient Haar mass `coeff_σ(stateLaw (S(1;r)))(q)`, `q = |k|`. It is the interface between the
measured recursion (which proves it) and the polynomial/projective assembly (which consumes it).
lean.statement:
def RootCellLaw : Prop :=
  ∀ (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O],
    IsAdic (maximalIdeal O) → ∀ (pi : O), Irreducible pi → ∀ (r : ℕ), 0 < r → ∀ (σ : FactorType),
      MeasurableSet {z : Fin r → O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ} ∧
      coefficientMeasure O r {z : Fin r → O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ} =
        densityValue (lawCoeff (stateLaw (State.single 1 r)) σ) (Nat.card (ResidueField O))

entries.summary: recip_main states, for n > 0 and every type σ, the identities of rational functions (monicExpr n σ).rational = (B_{n,σ} with q ↦ 1/q).rational, where B_{n,σ} = lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ, and (projectiveExpr n σ) is invariant under q ↦ 1/q. These are the coefficientwise forms of A_n = B_n^∨ and R_n^∨ = R_n. The hypotheses ValidType σ and typeDegree σ = n are unused.
entries.label: Theorem 1.2
entries.title: reciprocity

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.recip_main
lean.docstring:
**Theorem R (reciprocity).** For `n > 0` and every factorization type `σ`:
the universal monic density is the root-law coefficient with `q ↦ 1/q` substituted,
`A_{n,σ}(q) = B_{n,σ}(1/q)` (where `B_{n,σ}` is the coefficient of `σ` in the root law
`rootLaw n`), and the universal projective density is self-reciprocal,
`R_{n,σ}(1/q) = R_{n,σ}(q)`; both as identities of rational functions in `q`.

The certified form also assumed `ValidType σ` and `typeDegree σ = n`, which the proof does not use.
The hypothesis `0 < n` is used (`rootLaw 0` is defined separately).
lean.statement:
theorem recip_main (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (σ : FactorType) :
    (monicExpr n σ).rational =
      ((lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ).subst (.inv .var)).rational ∧
    (projectiveExpr n σ).rational =
      ((projectiveExpr n σ).subst (.inv .var)).rational

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr
lean.docstring:
**Main theorem.** Let `O` be a complete discrete valuation ring with finite residue field `k`
(any characteristic, any ramification), with its maximal-ideal-adic compact topology, Borel
σ-algebra and normalized Haar measure. For every degree `n` and every factorization type `σ`,
the probability that a random monic polynomial of degree `n` over `O` (resp. a random primitive
binary form of degree `n`) has type `σ` is the value at `q = |k|` of the universal rational
expression `monicExpr n σ` (resp. `projectiveExpr n σ`).

The statement carries no hypotheses on `n` and `σ`: the certified form assumed `0 < n`,
`ValidType σ` and `typeDegree σ = n`, none of which the proof uses.
lean.statement:
theorem main_dvr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
    (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    SurfaceBlowup.monicDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (monicExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) ∧
    SurfaceBlowup.projectiveDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (projectiveExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr_cluster
lean.docstring:
**Theorem 1.1, cluster clause.** Over every complete DVR with finite residue field of size
`q`, the cluster probability of type `σ` is `B_{n,σ}(q)`.
lean.statement:
theorem main_dvr_cluster (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      densityValue (clusterExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))

The certified form also assumed `ValidType σ` and `typeDegree σ = n`, which the proof does not use.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr_etale
lean.docstring:
Theorem 1.1 under the étale convention: the monic and projective laws, with the events
restricted to étale algebras, are the universal rational functions.
lean.statement:
theorem main_dvr_etale (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]

    etaleMonicDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (monicExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) ∧
    etaleProjectiveDensity O n σ =

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.clusterDensity_eq_etale
lean.docstring:
The cluster probability is unchanged by restricting the event to separable polynomials
(the étale convention).
lean.statement:
theorem clusterDensity_eq_etale (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n ∩
        {a | (monicPolynomial O a).Separable ∧ HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}) /
        coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.binary_nonEtale_null
lean.docstring: The non-étale binary forms are Haar-null.

theorem binary_nonEtale_null (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]

lean.docstring: The coefficients of inseparable monic polynomials form a null set for the coefficient measure.

    coefficientMeasure O n {a | ¬ (monicPolynomial O a).Separable} = 0

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.IsEtaleForm
lean.docstring:
The binary form `F_a` is étale of degree `n` (its zero scheme in `ℙ¹_K` is finite étale of
degree `n`): nonzero, degree drop at most one (so the point at infinity has multiplicity at most
one), and separable dehomogenization `F_a(X,1)`.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.etaleMonicDensity_eq_algebraType
lean.docstring:
The étale monic density, with the event "the algebra `K[X]/(f_a)` is étale and `O[X]/(f_a)`
has algebra type `σ`".
lean.statement:
theorem etaleMonicDensity_eq_algebraType (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    etaleMonicDensity O n σ = coefficientMeasure O n
      {a | Algebra.Etale (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot (monicPolynomial O a)) ∧
        HasAlgebraType O (AdjoinRoot (monicPolyO a)) σ}

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.member_cell_box_measure
lean.docstring:
The measure of the set of ideals in a cell whose strict transforms lie in a box `Π G_j` is
  `q^(-tri(cellDegree))` times the product of the child state measures of the `G_j`.
lean.statement:
theorem member_cell_box_measure :
    (letI : ∀ j, MeasurableSpace (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R) :=
      fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal;
      letI : MeasurableSpace (Ideal ℛ) := m.toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal;
      ∀ (G : ∀ j, Set (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j)) →
      m.toMeasured.μ (m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ (fun (J : Ideal ℛ) (j : 𝒥) =>
        strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) 𝔡 J) ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) =
      𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * ∏ j, (mc j).toMeasured.μ (G j))
lean.section_variables:
variable (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex)
    (mc : m.toMeasured.childIdx c → ConcreteMember)
variable [∀ j, Algebra m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O]
    [∀ j, Algebra m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R]
    [∀ j, IsScalarTower m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R]
    (pc : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.O ≃ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      (Fin (m.toMeasured.childDelta c j) → m.toMeasured.O))
    (hpc : ∀ j, Measurable (pc j)) (hpc' : ∀ j, Measurable (pc j).symm)
    (hcard : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.q = m.toMeasured.q ^ m.toMeasured.childDelta c j)
    (hpiO : ∀ j, algebraMap m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.S.pi =
      (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi)
    (hdeg : ∑ j, m.toMeasured.childDelta c j * (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree = m.toMeasured.s.degree)
    (alpha : ∀ j, m.toMeasured.R →ₐ[m.toMeasured.O] (mc j).toMeasured.R)
    (e : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) (he : ∀ j, e j = (mc j).toMeasured.S.t)
    (hvert : ∀ j, ∃ (s : ℕ) (cj : (mc j).toMeasured.R),
      algebraMap m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R m.toMeasured.S.pi ^ s =
      e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * cj)
    (hbij : Set.BijOn
      (fun (J : Ideal m.toMeasured.R) (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c) => strictTransformIdeal
      (alpha j) (e j) (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) J) (m.toMeasured.cell c)
      (Set.pi Set.univ fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet))
    (hstrict : ∀ f : m.toMeasured.R, Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c →
      ∃ g : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R), ∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * g j)
    (hindex : ∀ f : m.toMeasured.R, Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c →
      ∀ g : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R), (∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * g j) →
      ∀ iota : (m.toMeasured.R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      ((∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}),
      (∀ h : m.toMeasured.R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (fun j => alpha j h)) → Function.Injective iota ∧
      Module.length m.toMeasured.O
      (((∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range iota) =
      (chooseTwo (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) : ℕ∞))
    (hsum : ∑ j, m.toMeasured.childDelta c j * (mc j).toMeasured.s.firstContact =
      m.toMeasured.cellDegree c)

Analytic inversion / change of variables is not used: the Lean proof replaces it by finite-digit congruence arguments.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_finite_free
lean.docstring:
If the integral closure of a DVR `O` in a finite extension `L/K` is finite over `O`, it is
free of rank `[L : K]`.
lean.statement:
theorem integral_closure_finite_free (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] :
    Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L) ∧ Module.Free O (integralClosure O L) ∧
      Module.finrank O (integralClosure O L) = Module.finrank K L

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_is_dvr
lean.docstring:
The integral closure of a complete DVR with finite residue field in a finite extension
(assumed `O`-finite) is a DVR.
lean.statement:
theorem integral_closure_is_dvr (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L]
    [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (integralClosure O L)

prove2me.blueprint_source: restructured — G1, integral-closure bridge for Lemma 2.1 and Theorem 1.1

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_is_dvr
lean.role: O_δ is a complete DVR, residue size q^δ
lean.docstring:
For an unramified lift `Φ`, `O[X]/(Φ)` is a complete DVR with maximal ideal `𝔪 O[X]/(Φ)`, in
which every uniformizer of `O` stays a uniformizer, with finite residue field of cardinality
`q ^ deg Φ`.
lean.statement:
theorem unramified_is_dvr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    ∃ (_ : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (_ : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)),
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = baseIdeal O Φ ∧
      (∀ ϖ : O, Irreducible ϖ → Irreducible (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ)) ∧
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) ∧
      Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = residueCard O ^ Φ.natDegree

prove2me.blueprint_source: restructured — G7, unramified extension O_δ and Frobenius for Lemma 9.2

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_fixed_ring
lean.docstring: The elements of `O[X]/(Φ)` fixed by the Frobenius are exactly the elements of `O`.
lean.statement:
theorem frobenius_fixed_ring (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (a : AdjoinRoot Φ)
    (ha : unramifiedFrobenius O Φ a = a) :
    ∃ c : O, algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c = a

prove2me.blueprint_source: restructured — G7, unramified extension O_δ and Frobenius for Lemma 9.2

Recursion states: `single a c` is `S(a;c)` (one boundary component of multiplicity `a`, contact

inductive State where

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.SurfaceData
lean.role: surface with vertical equation π = u t^a x^b
lean.docstring:
Data of a regular complete two-dimensional local `O`-algebra `R` with parameters `t, x`,
residue field identified with that of `O`, and vertical equation `π = unit · t^a x^b`.
lean.statement:
structure SurfaceData where
  pi : O
  pi_irreducible : Irreducible pi
  t : R
  x : R
  unit : Rˣ
  a : ℕ
  b : ℕ
  a_pos : 0 < a
  parameters : Ideal.span {t,x} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  dimension : ringKrullDim R = 2
  complete : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
  base_injective : Function.Injective (algebraMap O R)
  residueEquiv : IsLocalRing.ResidueField O ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  residue_compat : ∀ c : O, residueEquiv (IsLocalRing.residue O c) =
    IsLocalRing.residue R (algebraMap O R c)
  vertical : algebraMap O R pi = (unit : R) * t^a * x^b

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.ConcreteSurface
lean.docstring: The concrete surface `O[[T,X]] / (π - u T^a X^b)`.

abbrev ConcreteSurface (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :=

entries.summary: Formalized for the concrete surfaces O⟦T,X⟧/(π − u T^a X^b): the special fibre is k⟦T,X⟧/(T^a X^b) (concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv), principal quotients have length ac resp. ac + bh (single/crossing_special_fiber_length), finite-contact elements are nonzerodivisors, and the curve order R/(f) is free of rank N (concrete_surface_curve_free_of_length, concrete_member_curve_order_free). The paper states it for every complete regular local ring with the given vertical equation.

entries.title: degree and flatness

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv
lean.docstring:
The special fiber of the concrete surface is `k[[T,X]]/(T^a X^b)`, compatibly with
reduction of coefficients.
lean.statement:
theorem concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
    ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b, ∀ s :
    TwoSeries O, e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) (residueSeries O s)

prove2me.blueprint_source: Lemma 2.1, equation (2.4) — the special fibre; restructured through coefficient reduction

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.single_special_fiber_length
lean.docstring:
A principal quotient of `k[[T,X]]/(T^a)` (with `a > 0`) by `f` has length `a c`, where `c` is
the contact of `f` with `T`.
lean.statement:
theorem single_special_fiber_length (k : Type) [Field k] (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : SpecialFiber k a 0) (hf : contact f (fiberT k a 0) = c) :
    Module.length (SpecialFiber k a 0) ((SpecialFiber k a 0) ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = a * c

prove2me.blueprint_source: Lemma 2.1 — single-boundary length; decomposed into N674–N679

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.crossing_special_fiber_length
lean.docstring:
A principal quotient of `k[[T,X]]/(T^a X^b)` (with `a, b > 0`) by `f` has length `a c + b h`,
where `c` and `h` are the contacts of `f` with `T` and with `X`.
lean.statement:
theorem crossing_special_fiber_length (k : Type) [Field k] (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (f : SpecialFiber k a b) (ht : contact f (fiberT k a b) = c)
    (hx : contact f (fiberX k a b) = h) :
    Module.length (SpecialFiber k a b) ((SpecialFiber k a b) ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = a * c + b * h

prove2me.blueprint_source: Lemma 2.1 — crossing length; decomposed into N674–N679

On the single special fiber `k⟦t, x⟧ ⧸ (tᵃ)` with `a > 0`, a function of finite contact with

theorem special_fiber_single_contact_regular (k : Type) [Field k] (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.special_fiber_crossing_contact_regular

contact with both axes is a nonzerodivisor.
lean.statement:
theorem special_fiber_crossing_contact_regular (k : Type) [Field k] (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : 0 < b) (f : SpecialFiber k a b) (ht : contact f (fiberT k a b) = c)
    (hx : contact f (fiberX k a b) = h) :
    Function.Injective (fun w : SpecialFiber k a b => f * w)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_curve_free_of_length
lean.role: A_f free of rank length R/(π,f)
lean.docstring:
For `f` regular modulo `π`, the curve ring `R/(f)` is free over `O` of rank
equal to the length of `R/(π, f)`.
lean.statement:
theorem concrete_surface_curve_free_of_length (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (hf : Function.Injective
      (fun w : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span
      {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi} => Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) f * w)) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi, f}) =
      N) :
    Module.Free O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ∧ Module.Finite O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ∧ Module.finrank O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = N

prove2me.blueprint_source: Lemma 2.1 — “the indicated lengths are also dimensions over k”; restructured as residue-basis families

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_member_curve_order_free
lean.role: A_f ≅ O^N on every recursion member
lean.docstring:
The curve order `R/J` of an ideal `J` in the state set of a concrete member is a free `O`-module
of rank the degree of the state.
lean.statement:
theorem concrete_member_curve_order_free (m : ConcreteMember) (J : Ideal m.R)
    (hJ : J ∈ m.toMeasured.stateSet) :
    Module.Free m.O (m.R ⧸ J) ∧ Module.Finite m.O (m.R ⧸ J) ∧ Module.finrank m.O (m.R ⧸ J) =
      m.s.degree

entries.summary: HasAlgebraType O B σ: the generic fibre of B is a finite product of fields whose O-integral closures are finite, with invariants σ. The Lean development uses this route-F convention (finite integral closures) everywhere in the recursion, and transfers to the published étale densities through the Haar-null bridges.
entries.label: Reduced-algebra type convention
entries.title: types of reduced algebras

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.HasAlgebraType
lean.docstring:
`HasAlgebraType O B σ`: the generic fibre K ⊗_O B (K = FractionRing O) is isomorphic as a
K-algebra to a finite product of finite field extensions L_i of K whose O-integral closures are
finite O-modules, and σ is the multiset of their invariants.
lean.statement:
def HasAlgebraType (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (L : ι → Type) (_ : ∀ i, Field (L i))
    (_ : ∀ i, Algebra (BaseField O) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra O (L i))
    (_ : ∀ i, IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) (L i))
    (_ : (BaseField O ⊗[O] B) ≃ₐ[BaseField O] (∀ i, L i)),
    σ = ∑ i, ({fieldInvariant O (L i)} : FactorType) ∧
      ∀ i, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (L i))
lean.section_variables: variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.fieldInvariant
lean.role: (e,f) of a field via its integral closure
lean.docstring:
The invariants (e,f) of the maximal ideal of the integral closure of O in an O-algebra L (a
field in the applications), with the junk value (0,0) when that closure is not local.
lean.statement:
noncomputable def fieldInvariant (L : Type) [CommRing L] [Algebra O L] : ℕ × ℕ := by
  classical
  let B := integralClosure O L
  exact if h : IsLocalRing B then
    letI : IsLocalRing B := h
    ((maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O, (maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg O)
  else (0,0)
lean.section_variables: variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.HasPolynomialTypeF
lean.docstring: `HasPolynomialType` together with finiteness of the integral closure in each root field.
lean.statement:
def HasPolynomialTypeF (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)),
    (∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) ∧ gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h) ∧
    F=gs.prod ∧ σ=(gs.map (factorInvariant O) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧
    ∀ g ∈ gs, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))
lean.section_variables: variable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

entries.summary: Single-boundary case: F_{S(a;1)} = Z_{a,1} is part of the definition of stateLaw (terminal_law), and its meaning is proved on the concrete surfaces (the curve order is a DVR with field invariant (a,1): terminal_curve_order_dvr, terminal_field_invariant, concrete_member_terminal_type). Crossing cases: in Lean only S(a;1) is terminal; the laws of T(a,b;1,h) and T(a,b;c,1) are computed from the recursion in the private regression lemmas crossing_left_one_law / crossing_right_one_law (for rational q > 1), matching Z_{a+bh,1} and Z_{ac+b,1}.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.terminal_law
lean.docstring: The law of the terminal state `S(a; 1)` is the atom `[(a, 1)]`.

theorem terminal_law (a : ℕ) :
    stateLaw (State.single a 1) = lawAtom a 1

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.terminal_curve_order_dvr
lean.role: R/(f) is a DVR with uniformizer t
lean.docstring:
In the terminal state `single a 1`, the curve order `R/J` is a DVR with uniformizer `t`, and
the maximal ideal of `O` extends to the `a`-th power of its maximal ideal.
lean.statement:
theorem terminal_curve_order_dvr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (hSpi : S.pi = pi)
    (hSt : S.t = (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (hSx : S.x = (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (hSa : S.a = a)
    (hSb : S.b = b) (J : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hJ : J ∈ surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S (State.single a 1))
    (f : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (hf : J = Ideal.span {f}) :
    ∃ (_ : IsDomain ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J)) (_ : IsLocalRing
        ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J)),
    IsDiscreteValuationRing ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J) ∧
    Irreducible (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (surfaceT O pi u a b)) ∧
    Ideal.map (algebraMap O ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J) : O →+*
        ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J)) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) =
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J))^a

prove2me.blueprint_source: §8.1, equation (8.4) — the terminal state S(a;1): R/(f) is a complete DVR with uniformizer t, of type {(a,1)}; restructured (cycle 8)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.terminal_field_invariant
lean.docstring:
In the terminal state `single a 1`, the generic fibre of the curve order has field invariant
`(a, 1)`: ramification index `a` and residue degree `1`.
lean.statement:
theorem terminal_field_invariant (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (hSpi : S.pi = pi)
    (hSt : S.t = (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (hSx : S.x = (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (hSa : S.a = a)
    (hSb : S.b = b) (J : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hJ : J ∈ surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S (State.single a 1))
    (f : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (hf : J = Ideal.span {f}) (B : Type) [CommRing B]
    [Algebra O B] (eB : B ≃ₐ[O] ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ J)) :
    fieldInvariant O (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) B) = (a, 1)

prove2me.blueprint_source: §8.1, equation (8.4) — the terminal state S(a;1): R/(f) is a complete DVR with uniformizer t, of type {(a,1)}; restructured (cycle 8)

entries.summary: Residue ideals of the special fibre with prescribed contacts (singleResidueIdeals, crossingResidueIdeals); a cell is the set of ideals with fixed order d and tangent divisor (HasTangentDivisor); tangent patterns record the combinatorics of a divisor (TangentPattern, Allowed).
entries.label: Allowed residue ideals, cells, occupied points
entries.title: geometric terms

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.singleResidueIdeals
lean.docstring: Principal ideals of `k[[T,X]]/(T^a)` with contact `c` against `T`.
lean.statement:
def singleResidueIdeals (k : Type) [CommRing k] (a c : ℕ) :=
  {I : Ideal (SpecialFiber k a 0) // ∃ f, I=Ideal.span {f} ∧ contact f (fiberT k a 0)=c}

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingResidueIdeals
lean.docstring: Principal ideals of `k[[T,X]]/(T^a X^b)` with contacts `c` against `T` and `h` against `X`.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.HasTangentDivisor
lean.docstring:
The principal ideal `J` has tangent cone of degree `d` with divisor `D` on the
exceptional line.
lean.statement:
def HasTangentDivisor (S : SurfaceData O R) (J : Ideal R) (d : ℕ)
    (D : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : R, ∃ H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R),
    J = Ideal.span {f} ∧ HasHomogeneousDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) d H D ∧
      f - tangentLift O R S d H ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)^(d+1)
lean.section_variables:
variable (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
  [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.TangentPattern
lean.docstring:
A tangent pattern of a state of degree `n`: the tangent degree `d`, the boundary contacts
`rt`, `rx`, and the pattern of the other points.
lean.statement:
structure TangentPattern (n : ℕ) where
  d : Fin (n+1)
  rt : Fin (n+1)
  rx : Fin (n+1)
  other : Pattern n
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Allowed
lean.docstring: The admissible tangent patterns of a state (Proposition 5.1).
lean.statement:
def Allowed (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Prop :=
  0<P.d.val ∧ P.rt.val+P.rx.val+patternWeight P.other=P.d.val ∧
  match s with
  | .single _ c => P.d.val≤c ∧ P.rx.val=0 ∧ (0<P.rt.val ↔ P.d.val<c)
  | .crossing _ _ c h => P.d.val≤c ∧ P.d.val≤h ∧
      (0<P.rt.val ↔ P.d.val<c) ∧ (0<P.rx.val ↔ P.d.val<h)

entries.summary: Lean uses a different well-founded measure, State.rank = 2N² + 2(N − w) + tag, and proves that every non-self child has strictly smaller rank (nonself_child_rank_lt); this plays the role of the paper's contact-size order in every induction.
entries.label: Contact-size order
entries.title: induction order on states

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.State.rank
lean.docstring: The well-founded rank `2d² + 2(d - w) + tag` driving the recursion.
lean.statement: def rank (s : State) : ℕ := 2*s.degree*s.degree + 2*(s.degree-s.weight) + s.tag

entries.summary: The division maps (3.1) are division_linear_equivalence (from a lifted basis of R/(f)) and the unique factorization (3.2) is unique_scaled_generator_normalization: every f + πh is uniquely (1 + πu)(f + π Σ zᵢbᵢ). The analytic-dependence part (3.3)–(3.4) is not formalized; the formal proof uses instead that the normalization preserves π-adic congruences (normalizer_preserves_adic_congruence, coordinate_transition_congruence).

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.division_linear_equivalence
lean.docstring:
If `b` lifts an `O`-basis of `R/(f)` with `f ≠ 0` in a domain, the division map is the
inverse of an `O`-linear equivalence `R ≃ O^n × R`.
lean.statement:
theorem division_linear_equivalence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (f : R) (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) O (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (b : Fin n → R)
    (hb : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (b i) = B i) [IsDomain R] (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R), ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s

prove2me.blueprint_source: restructured — G3, finite-digit proof of Lemmas 3.1–3.2

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.unique_scaled_generator_normalization
lean.docstring: Every `f + π h` is uniquely of the form `(1 + π u) (f + π Σ zᵢ bᵢ)`.
lean.statement:
theorem unique_scaled_generator_normalization (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) [IsDomain R] (pi : O) (hpi : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0) (f : R) (b : Fin n → R)
    (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (h : R) :
    ∃! s : (Fin n → O) × R, (1 + pi • s.2) * (f + pi • coordinateLift b s.1) = f + pi • h

prove2me.blueprint_source: restructured — G3, finite-digit proof of Lemmas 3.1–3.2

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.scaled_normalization_identity
lean.docstring:
The normalization identity `(1 + π v)(f + π ∑ zᵢ bᵢ) = f + π E⁻¹(s + remainder s)` for a
division chart.
lean.statement:
theorem scaled_normalization_identity (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (f : R) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s) (s : (Fin n → O) × R) :
    (1 + pi • s.2) * (f + pi • coordinateLift b s.1) =
      f + pi • E.symm (adicPerturb (coordinateRemainder pi b E) s)

private theorem normalizer_preserves_adic_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]

    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))

The transition between the coordinates of two normalizations preserves congruence modulo
  `(π)^j`.
lean.statement:
theorem coordinate_transition_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (c : Fin n → R)
    (F : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (h0 : R) (j : ℕ) (z w : Fin n → O)
    (hzw : adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z w) :
    adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j (idealTransition pi b c F h0 z)
      (idealTransition pi b c F h0 w)

entries.summary: The chart (3.5) is a bijection onto its residue-ideal cell (coordinate_ideal_cell_bijection); chart transitions preserve Haar measure (ideal_chart_transition_haar, the formal counterpart of 'unit Jacobian'), so the pushed-forward chart measures and the state measure of an atlas are independent of choices (ideal_chart_pushforward_independent, state_measure_atlas_independent). The tangent-lattice statement is not formalized.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_ideal_cell_bijection
lean.docstring:
The coordinate-ideal map of a division chart is a bijection onto the residue-ideal cell of
`f`.
lean.statement:
theorem coordinate_ideal_cell_bijection (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hp0 : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0) (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (f : R)
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s)
    (hf : Function.Injective
      (fun x : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} => x *
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f))
    :
    Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal pi f b) ∧ Set.range (coordinateIdeal pi f b) =
      residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) f

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.IdealChart
lean.docstring:
A division chart of rank `n`: a generator `f` regular modulo `π` with representatives `b`
and an `O`-linear equivalence `E` inverse to the division map.
lean.statement:
structure IdealChart (pi : O) (n : ℕ) where
  /-- The centre generator. -/
  f : R
  /-- The coordinate representatives. -/
  b : Fin n → R
  /-- The division equivalence. -/
  E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)
  division : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s
  regular : Function.Injective (fun y : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} =>
    y * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f)

entries.summary: State volumes q^{-c} and (q−1)q^{-c-h} are proved for any ideal atlas indexed by the residue ideals (single_state_volume, crossing_state_volume), from the residue-ideal counts q^{ac−c} and (q−1)q^{ac+bh−c−h}; the concrete surfaces admit such atlases (concrete_single/crossing_state_volume). The total state measure of a single state with contact `c` is `q^(-c)`, where `q` is the residue
  cardinality.

theorem single_state_volume (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (pi : O) (X : Set (Ideal R))
    (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (A : IdealAtlas O R pi (a * c) X)
    (hA : ∀ i, Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi (A.chart i).f (A.chart i).b))
    (hcount : Nonempty (A.ι ≃ singleResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a c)) :
    stateMeasure O R pi (a*c) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A Set.univ =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^c

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.stateVolume
lean.docstring: The volume `q^{-c}` (resp. `(q - 1) q^{-(c+h)}`) of a state.
lean.statement:
def stateVolume : State → Expr
  | .single _ c => .inv (.pow .var c)
  | .crossing _ _ c h => .mul eminusOne (.inv (.pow .var (c+h)))

entries.summary: The Lean development has no formal scheme; it works with the two blow-up charts R[x/t], R[t/x] and their exceptional filtrations. The layers I^j/I^{j+1} are identified with polynomial modules on a chart and Laurent-polynomial modules on the overlap, which is the content of 𝓘^j/𝓘^{j+1} ≅ 𝒪_E(j).
entries.title: layers of the exceptional thickenings

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_layer_polynomial_coordinates
lean.docstring:
Each exceptional layer of the chart is `R`-linearly isomorphic to `(R/(t,x))[Z]`, the monomial
`r Z^i` corresponding to the layer class of `r · z^i`.
lean.statement:
theorem chart_layer_polynomial_coordinates (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer (BlowupChart R t x)
    (chartBase R t x t) j, ∀ r : R, ∀ i : ℕ,
    (L (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) * Polynomial.X^i)).val =
    principalLayerMap (BlowupChart R t x) (chartBase R t x t) j

theorem actual_finite_cech_coefficient_length (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]

      (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) :

      (CechLevelOutput R t x n ⧸ LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d n (hpres n)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.child_ideals_curve_datum
lean.role: prescribed children give a curve datum
lean.docstring:
Every family of child ideals over the support of `Dv` is realized by a two-chart curve datum
matching `Dv`: any global function with the prescribed chart strict transforms has strict
transform `I Q` at every point `Q`.
lean.statement:
theorem child_ideals_curve_datum (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
        [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (e : (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
        (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b) (tSlope O pi u a b)) = Polynomial.X)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hinf : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime) (s : State) (d : ℕ)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (I : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, Ideal (divisorLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf Q))
    (hI : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, I Q ∈ childIdealSet (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf s d Q) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        beta, MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧ ∀ f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b,
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
            (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) →
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
          (surfaceT O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
        Ideal.span {rightData D s}) →
      ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, divisorStrictTransform (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
          (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf d (Ideal.span {f}) Q =
        I Q

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.glued_generators_exist
lean.docstring:
Compatible systems of chart generators `gA`, `gB` that are regular, agree on the overlap and are
normalized at level one can be replaced by glued generators generating the same ideals at every
level.
lean.statement:
theorem glued_generators_exist (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (d : ℕ)
    (gA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x) (gB : ℕ → BlowupChart R x t)
    (hA : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA (j+1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)})
    (hB : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB (j+1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)})
    (hregA : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupChart R t x ⧸ (chartExceptional R t x)^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j) * c))
    (hregBc : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupChart R x t ⧸ (chartExceptional R x t)^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j) * c))
    (hoverlap : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (gA j))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) (beta.right (gB j))})
    (hregC : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) (beta.right (gB j)) * c))
    (hnorm : ∃ u : Rˣ, (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (gA 1) - algebraMap
      R (BlowupOverlap R t x) (u : R) * ((overlapSlope R t x)^d * beta.right (gB 1)) ∈
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})) :
    ∃ G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d, ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)} ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)}

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_global_function_exists
lean.docstring:
A two-chart curve datum on a complete regular local surface comes
from a global function `f` whose glued level generators cut out the left and right level kernels.
lean.statement:
theorem two_chart_global_function_exists (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta : BlowupRestriction
    R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)]
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {t,x}) R] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) :
    ∃ f : R, ∃ G : GluedGenerators R t x beta (curveDataDegree D),
        (∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f = (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R
        t x G j)) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)}
        = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
        Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D
        j

lean.docstring:
The principal ideal `J` has tangent cone of degree `d` with divisor `D` on the

def HasTangentDivisor (S : SurfaceData O R) (J : Ideal R) (d : ℕ)
    (D : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : R, ∃ H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R),
    J = Ideal.span {f} ∧ HasHomogeneousDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) d H D ∧
      f - tangentLift O R S d H ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)^(d+1)

lean.docstring: A homogeneous divisor of the initial form of `f` is a tangent divisor of `(f)`.

theorem initial_form_has_tangent_divisor (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (d : ℕ) (f : R) (c : Fin (d + 1) → R)
    (hc : f = (∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * S.t ^ (d - i.val) * S.x ^ i.val))
    (H : Polynomial (ResidueField R)) (hH : H = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), Polynomial.C (residue R (c i)) *
    Polynomial.X ^ i.val) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (ResidueField R))

lean.docstring:
Boundary multiplicities of the homogeneous divisor of `H`: positive at infinity iff `H_d = 0`,
positive at zero iff `H_0 = 0`, and all multiplicities and degrees of support points at most `d`.

theorem homogeneous_divisor_boundary_multiplicities (k : Type) [Field k] (d : ℕ) (H : Polynomial k)
    (hH : H ≠ 0) (hdeg : H.natDegree ≤ d) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k)
    (hinf : Dv (infinityDirection k) = d - H.natDegree) (haff : ∀ φ : AffineDirection k, Dv (some φ)
    = Multiset.count φ.val (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors H)) :
    (0 < Dv (infinityDirection k) ↔ H.coeff d = 0) ∧ (0 < Dv (zeroDirection k) ↔ H.coeff 0 = 0) ∧
      (∀ Q : ClosedDirection k, Dv Q ≤ d) ∧ ∀ Q : ClosedDirection k, 0 < Dv Q → directionDegree k Q
      ≤ d

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.children
lean.docstring: All children (residue degree, child state) of a state under a tangent pattern.
lean.statement:
def children (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : List (ℕ × State) :=
  match s with
  | .single a c =>
    (if P.rt.val=0 then [] else [(1,.crossing a a P.rt.val (c-P.d.val))]) ++
      otherChildren a P.other
  | .crossing a b c h =>
    (if P.rt.val=0 then [] else [(1,.crossing (a+b) a P.rt.val (c-P.d.val))]) ++
    (if P.rx.val=0 then [] else [(1,.crossing (a+b) b P.rx.val (h-P.d.val))]) ++
      otherChildren (a+b) P.other

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.otherChildren
lean.docstring: The children `(δ, S(a; j + 1))` contributed by the non-boundary points of a pattern.

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Allowed
lean.docstring: The admissible tangent patterns of a state (Proposition 5.1).
lean.statement:
def Allowed (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Prop :=
  0<P.d.val ∧ P.rt.val+P.rx.val+patternWeight P.other=P.d.val ∧
  match s with
  | .single _ c => P.d.val≤c ∧ P.rx.val=0 ∧ (0<P.rt.val ↔ P.d.val<c)
  | .crossing _ _ c h => P.d.val≤c ∧ P.d.val≤h ∧
      (0<P.rt.val ↔ P.d.val<c) ∧ (0<P.rx.val ↔ P.d.val<h)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_curve_order_index
lean.docstring:
For a concrete surface, the child-order map is `O`-linear with kernel `(f)` and cokernel of
  length `binom(d, 2)`, where `d` is the curve degree.
lean.statement:
theorem concrete_curve_order_index (beta : BlowupRestriction 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta) (f : 𝒮) (G : GluedGenerators 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta (curveDataDegree D))
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 j f =
      (cechInputLattice 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 G j))
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳)^j) (G.left j)} =
        leftLevelKernel D j ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯)^j) (G.right j)} =
        rightLevelKernel D j) :
    (letI : ∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p) :=
      fun p => ((localFromSurface D p).comp (algebraMap O 𝒮)).toAlgebra;
        ∃ φ : 𝒮 →ₗ[O] childOrder D, (∀ r : 𝒮, φ r = childOrderMap D r) ∧
        RingHom.ker (childOrderMap D) = Ideal.span {f} ∧
        Module.length O (childOrder D ⧸ LinearMap.range φ) =
        (chooseTwo (curveDataDegree D) : ℕ∞))

    (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hregF : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective
      (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
          ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j)) * c))
    (f : R)
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j))
    (hclosed : (⨅ j : ℕ, (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ (Ideal.span {t,x})^j)) = Ideal.span {f})
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsLocalRing (localRing D p)]
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsNoetherianRing (localRing D p)]
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (localRing D p)]
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p)]
    (E : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G ≃ₗ[O] childOrder D) (σ : R →ₗ[R] CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G)

      childOrderMap D r)

      Module.length O ((childOrder D) ⧸ LinearMap.range φ) = (chooseTwo d : ℕ∞)

**The index map of a cell.** For a cell ideal `J` of a concrete member and child quotients
`B j ≅ R_j ⧸ Φ J j`, there is an injective `O`-algebra map `R ⧸ J → ∏ B j` with cokernel of length
`d(d-1)/2` (`d` the cell degree), compatible with the child maps `α j`.
lean.statement:
theorem cell_member_index_map (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.cellIndex) (D : CellChildData m c)
    (J : Ideal m.R) (hJ : J ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c) (B : m.toMeasured.childIdx c → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra m.O (B j)] (eB : ∀ j, B j ≃+* (D.mc j).R ⧸ D.Φ J j)
    (hB : ∀ (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c) (r : m.O), eB j (algebraMap m.O (B j) r) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (D.Φ J j) (algebraMap m.O (D.mc j).R r)) :
    ∃ ψ : (m.R ⧸ J) →ₐ[m.O] ∀ j, B j, Function.Injective ψ ∧ Module.length m.O
        ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) = (chooseTwo (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) : ℕ∞)
        ∧ ∀ (r : m.R) (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c), eB j (ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J r) j) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (D.Φ J j) (D.alpha j r)

entries.summary: member_cell_box_measure: for a cell of a concrete recursion member and measurable child sets G_j, μ(cell ∩ ST⁻¹(∏ G_j)) = q^{-tri d} ∏ μ_j(G_j), where tri d = C(d+1,2). lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_quotient_cokernel_length
lean.role: determinant: cokernel length s·N − tri d
lean.docstring:
Length of the cokernel of the strict quotient map `phi`: it equals `s * N - tri d`, computed
from the relation `e ^ d * phi = pi ^ s • iota` and the cokernel lengths of `iota`, `e`, `pi`.
lean.statement:
theorem strict_quotient_cokernel_length (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C) (d : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (s : ℕ) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c) (N : ℕ)
    (phi iota : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
    (hphi : ∀ h : R, phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    (c * alpha h))
    (hiota : ∀ h : R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {g}) (alpha h))
    (hindex : Module.length O ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range iota) = (chooseTwo d : ℕ∞))
    (hereg : Function.Injective
    (fun y : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e * y))
    (hechild : Module.length O
    ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range
    (LinearMap.mulLeft O (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e))) = (d : ℕ∞))
    (hpireg : Function.Injective (fun y : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => (pi : O) • y))
    (hpiquot : Module.length O
    ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range
    ((pi : O) • (LinearMap.id : (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g})))) = (N : ℕ∞))
    (hsmall : tri d ≤ s*N) :
    Module.length O ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range phi) = ((s*N - tri d : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

theorem member_center_linear_part (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex)

    [∀ j, Algebra m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R]
    [∀ j, IsScalarTower m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R]

    (alpha : ∀ j, m.toMeasured.R →ₐ[m.toMeasured.O] (mc j).toMeasured.R)
    (e : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) (he : ∀ j, e j = (mc j).toMeasured.S.t)
    (hbij : Set.BijOn
      (fun (J : Ideal m.toMeasured.R) (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c) => strictTransformIdeal
      (alpha j) (e j) (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) J) (m.toMeasured.cell c)
      (Set.pi Set.univ fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet))
    (hindex : ∀ f : m.toMeasured.R, Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c →
      ∀ g : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R), (∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * g j) →
      ∀ iota : (m.toMeasured.R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      ((∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}),
      (∀ h : m.toMeasured.R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) =

    (hsum : ∑ j, m.toMeasured.childDelta c j * (mc j).toMeasured.s.firstContact =
      m.toMeasured.cellDegree c)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : tri (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) ≤ s) (cc : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R))
    (hcc : (algebraMap m.toMeasured.O (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) m.toMeasured.S.pi) ^ s =

    (g : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R)) (hg : ∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * g j)

theorem strict_chart_one_ball_measure (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (k : ℕ)
    (ha : k < a) (Q : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O))
    (hQ : ∀ w, normalizationLinearPart E H (Q w) = (pi ^ k) • w)
    (hD : Function.Injective (normalizationLinearPart E H)) [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (hk : Module.length O ((Fin n → O) ⧸ LinearMap.range (normalizationLinearPart E H)) = k)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O)] [TopologicalSpace (Fin n → O)]
    [IsTopologicalAddGroup (Fin n → O)] [CompactSpace (Fin n → O)] [T2Space (Fin n → O)]
    [MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)] [BorelSpace (Fin n → O)] [MeasurableAdd (Fin n → O)]
    (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)› = adicCylinderSpace (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O))
    (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin n → O)) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure mu]
    (hfinite : ∀ j, Finite (AdicQuotient (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O) j))
    (hcont : Continuous (fun z : Fin n → O => (pi^a) • normalizationLinearPart E H z))
    (hscale : ∀ (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n → O)), MeasurableSet S →
      mu ((fun w : Fin n → O => (pi^m) • w) '' S) =
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(m*n) * mu S)
    (s d : ℕ) (htri : tri d ≤ s*n) (hkd : k = s*n - tri d) (T : Set (Fin n → O))
    (hT : MeasurableSet T) :
    mu (coordinateScale pi (s+a-1) '' (childCoordinateMap pi a b E H ⁻¹' T)) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(tri d) *

On `O[x] ⧸ (Φ)` the coefficient Haar measure is the product of the power-coordinate measures,
  and a ball of radius `L` in `r` coordinates has mass `q^(-deg Φ · r · L)`.

theorem unramified_coefficient_measure_pi (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hτ : ‹TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedTopology O Φ hΦ.1)
    (hmeas : ‹MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedMeasurableSpace O Φ hΦ.1)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [IsTopologicalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [CompactSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    [T2Space (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [SecondCountableTopology (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [BorelSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hΦ.1)] (r : ℕ) :
    coefficientMeasure (AdjoinRoot Φ) r =
      MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin r => unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hΦ.1) ∧

      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (Φ.natDegree * r * L)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.divisorProbability
lean.docstring: The probability of the tangent divisor degree `d` (equation (7.2)).
lean.statement:
def divisorProbability (s : State) (d : ℕ) : Expr :=
  match s with
  | .single _ c => .mul (.inv (.pow .var (tri d))) (.pow eminusOne (if d<c then 1 else 0))
  | .crossing _ _ c h =>
    let j := (if d<c then 1 else 0) + (if d<h then 1 else 0)
    .mul (.inv (.pow .var (chooseTwo d)))
      (if j=0 then .inv eminusOne else .pow eminusOne (j-1))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.child_volume_ratio
lean.docstring:
The volume recursion: the children of an allowed tangent pattern `P` at a state `s`,
weighted by `q^(-tri d)`, have total volume `divisorProbability s d · stateVolume s`.
lean.statement:
theorem child_volume_ratio (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)

The number of monic irreducible polynomials of degree `δ > 0` over a finite field `k` is the

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.divisorCount
lean.docstring: The number of residue divisors with pattern `m` (choices of distinct points per degree).
lean.statement:
def divisorCount {n : ℕ} (offset : ℤ) (m : Pattern n) : Expr :=
  Expr.prod ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).toList.map fun i =>
    .mul (falling (availablePoints offset (i.val+1)) (∑ j : Fin n, (m (i,j)).val))
      (.const (1 / (∏ j : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (m (i,j)).val : ℕ) : ℚ)))))

lean.docstring: The number of tangent divisors with the pattern of `P`.

def tangentCount (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Expr :=
  divisorCount (match s with | .single _ _ => 0 | .crossing _ _ _ _ => -1) P.other

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.falling

def falling (x : Expr) (m : ℕ) : Expr :=
  Expr.prod ((List.range m).map fun j => .sub x (.const j))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.pattern_divisor_count
lean.docstring:
For an allowed pattern over a finite field `k`, there are finitely many divisors with
pattern `P`, and their number is `tangentCount s P` evaluated at `#k`.

theorem pattern_divisor_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (hP : Allowed s P) :
    Finite (patternDivisors k s P) ∧
      ((Nat.card (patternDivisors k s P) : ℕ) : ℚ) = (tangentCount s P).eval (Nat.card k)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.patternDivisors_equiv_colorings
lean.docstring:
Over a finite field, the exceptional divisors with tangent pattern `P` are in bijection
with tuples, indexed by degrees `i + 1`, of colorings of the nonboundary directions of that
degree by `Fin s.degree ⊕ none` with color counts `P.other (i, j)`.
lean.statement:
theorem patternDivisors_equiv_colorings (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (hP : P.rt.val + P.rx.val + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val)
    (hrx : ∀ a c, s = State.single a c → P.rx.val = 0) :
    Nonempty (patternDivisors k s P ≃ ∀ i : Fin s.degree,
      {f : {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
          directionDegree k Q = i.val + 1} → Option (Fin s.degree) //
        ∀ j : Fin s.degree, Nat.card {Q // f Q = some j} = (P.other (i, j)).val})

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.nonboundary_direction_count
lean.docstring:
Over a finite field `k`, the number of nonboundary closed directions of degree `δ > 0` is
the value at `q = #k` of `availablePoints` (with offset `-1` at a crossing state, where the
zero direction is also boundary).
lean.statement:
theorem nonboundary_direction_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State) (δ : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ((Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
        directionDegree k Q = δ} : ℕ) : ℚ) =
      (availablePoints
        (match s with | State.single _ _ => (0 : ℤ) | State.crossing _ _ _ _ => (-1 : ℤ))
        δ).eval (Nat.card k)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.exitLaw
lean.docstring:
The non-self part of the recursion of a state `s`: over the allowed tangent patterns `P` that
are not self patterns, the weight `tangentCount · divisorProbability` times the product of the
descended laws of the children of `P`.

noncomputable def exitLaw (s : State) : Law :=
  (allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
    if SelfPattern s P then [] else

        (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.stateLawFuel
lean.docstring: The measured recursion of §8 with explicit fuel.
lean.statement:
noncomputable def stateLawFuel : ℕ → State → Law
  | 0, _ => []
  | k+1, s =>
    match s with
    | .single a 1 => lawAtom a 1
    | _ =>
      let terms := (allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P =>
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel k z.2)))
      match s with
      | .single _ c => lawScale (.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c))) terms
      | .crossing _ _ _ _ => terms

theorem state_law_unfold (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (hnt : s.terminal = false) :
    (∀ a c : ℕ, s = State.single a c → stateLaw s =
      lawScale (.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c))) (exitLaw s)) ∧
      (∀ a b c h : ℕ, s = State.crossing a b c h → stateLaw s = exitLaw s)

Unfolding of the state law: for a single state it is the exit law rescaled by
`1 / (1 - returnWeight c)`, and for a crossing state it is the exit law itself.
lean.statement:
theorem state_law_unfold (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (hnt : s.terminal = false) :
    (∀ a c : ℕ, s = State.single a c → stateLaw s =
      lawScale (.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c))) (exitLaw s)) ∧
      (∀ a b c h : ℕ, s = State.crossing a b c h → stateLaw s = exitLaw s)

lean.docstring: `HasPolynomialType` together with finiteness of the integral closure in each root field.
lean.statement:
def HasPolynomialTypeF (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)),
    (∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) ∧ gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h) ∧
    F=gs.prod ∧ σ=(gs.map (factorInvariant O) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧
    ∀ g ∈ gs, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_event_succ_mass
lean.docstring:
If the immediate exit event at `single a c` has mass `G · vol`, then the exit event after
`k` returns has mass `λᵏ · G · vol`, where `λ` is the return weight; it is measurable.
lean.statement:
theorem exit_event_succ_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
    (σ : FactorType) (q₀ : ℕ) (G : ℚ)
    (hexit : ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → (U.M i).q = q₀ → (U.M i).μ
        (U.exitEvent σ 0 i) = ENNReal.ofReal (G : ℝ) * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧ MeasurableSet
        (U.exitEvent σ 0 i))
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → (U.M i).q = q₀ →
    (U.M i).μ (U.exitEvent σ k i) = ENNReal.ofReal ((((returnWeight c).eval (q₀ : ℚ)) ^ k * G : ℚ) :
        ℝ) * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧
    MeasurableSet (U.exitEvent σ k i)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.return_event_mass
lean.docstring:
At `single a c`, the event of returning `k` times has mass `λᵏ · vol`, with `λ` the return
weight, and is measurable.
lean.statement:
theorem return_event_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s = State.single a c →
    (U.M i).μ (U.returnEvent k i) = densityValue ((returnWeight c).pow k) (U.M i).q * (U.M i).μ
        (U.M i).stateSet ∧
    MeasurableSet (U.returnEvent k i)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad
lean.docstring:
A nonterminating ideal either returns infinitely often or eventually exits through a bad
cell; in a crossing state it exits through a bad cell at once.
lean.statement:
theorem nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false) :
    (∀ a c : ℕ, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → U.nonterminatingSet i ⊆ (⋂ k, U.returnEvent k i) ∪ ⋃
      k, U.badExitEvent k i) ∧ (∀ a b c h : ℕ, (U.M i).s = State.crossing a b c h →
      U.nonterminatingSet i ⊆ U.badExitEvent 0 i)

theorem single_two_law (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
