lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.RootCellLaw
lean.docstring:
`RootCellLaw`: for every complete DVR `O` with finite residue field and a compact adic
Borel structure, every uniformizer `pi`, every `r ≥ 1` and every type `σ`, the event
`{z : Fin r → O | X^r + ∑ (pi z_i) X^i has type σ}` is measurable and has normalized
coefficient Haar mass `coeff_σ(stateLaw (S(1;r)))(q)`, `q = |k|`. It is the interface between the
measured recursion (which proves it) and the polynomial/projective assembly (which consumes it).
lean.statement:
def RootCellLaw : Prop :=
  ∀ (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O],
    IsAdic (maximalIdeal O) → ∀ (pi : O), Irreducible pi → ∀ (r : ℕ), 0 < r → ∀ (σ : FactorType),
      MeasurableSet {z : Fin r → O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ} ∧
      coefficientMeasure O r {z : Fin r → O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ} =
        densityValue (lawCoeff (stateLaw (State.single 1 r)) σ) (Nat.card (ResidueField O))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.repeated_root_one_chart_atlas
lean.role: one-chart atlas of S(1;r) on O⟦x⟧
lean.docstring:
The state `single 1 r` on the concrete surface `(1, 1, 0)` admits a one-chart ideal atlas,
with chart `x^r` and basis `(x^i)`, whose state measure is `q⁻ʳ` times the pushforward of the
coefficient measure under the coordinate ideal map.
lean.statement:
theorem repeated_root_one_chart_atlas (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0)] [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0)) (hSpi : S.pi = pi)
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi 1 1 0) (hSa : S.a = 1)
    (hSb : S.b = 0) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ A : IdealAtlas O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0) S.pi (State.single 1 r).degree
      (surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0) S (State.single 1 r)),
    ∃ i₀ : A.ι, (∀ i, i = i₀) ∧
    (A.chart i₀).f = (surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) ^ (State.single 1 r).degree ∧
    (A.chart i₀).b = (fun i : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree ↦ (surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) ^ i.val) ∧
    (letI : MeasurableSpace (Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0)) :=
      idealChartSigma O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0) S.pi
    stateMeasure O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0) S.pi (State.single 1 r).degree
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A =
    ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (State.single 1 r).degree) •
      (coefficientMeasure O (State.single 1 r).degree).map
        (coordinateIdeal S.pi ((surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) ^ (State.single 1 r).degree)
          (fun i : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree ↦ (surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) ^ i.val)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.series_quotient_equiv_adjoinRoot
lean.docstring:
For monic `F` of degree `r > 0` whose lower coefficients lie in the maximal ideal, the
quotient of the concrete surface `(1, 1, 0)` by `F(x)` is `O`-isomorphic to `AdjoinRoot F`,
compatibly with evaluation of polynomials at `x`.
lean.statement:
theorem series_quotient_equiv_adjoinRoot (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (F : Polynomial O) (hF : F.Monic) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdeg : F.natDegree = r) (hred : ∀ i : ℕ, i < r → F.coeff i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) :
    ∃ e : (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0 ⧸
        Ideal.span {Polynomial.aeval (surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) F}) ≃ₐ[O] AdjoinRoot F,
      ∀ P : Polynomial O, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.span {Polynomial.aeval (surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) F})
        (Polynomial.aeval (surfaceX O pi 1 1 0) P)) = AdjoinRoot.mk F P

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_cells_partition
lean.docstring:
**Monic cell partition.** The monic polynomials of degree `n` over `O` are partitioned into the
residue cells of the affine divisors of degree `n` over the residue field: there are finitely many
such divisors, every coefficient vector lies in exactly one cell, each cell is measurable of mass
`q⁻ⁿ`, and the coefficient measure decomposes as a sum over cells.
lean.statement:
theorem monic_cells_partition (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∃ S : Finset (ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)), ∀ D, D ∈ S ↔ AffineDivisor
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D) ∧ (∀ a : Fin n → O, ∃! D : ExceptionalDivisor
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O), AffineDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D ∧ a ∈
      residueCell O n (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D)) ∧
      (∀ D : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O), AffineDivisor
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D → MeasurableSet (residueCell O n
      (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D)) ∧ coefficientMeasure O n
      (residueCell O n (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D)) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n ∧ ∀ E : Set (Fin n → O),
      coefficientMeasure O n (E ∩ residueCell O n
      (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D)) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n * cellMeasure O n
      (residueCell O n (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D)) E) ∧ ∀ S : Finset
      (ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)),
      (∀ D, D ∈ S ↔ AffineDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D) → ∀ E : Set (Fin n → O),
      MeasurableSet E → coefficientMeasure O n E = ∑ D ∈ S, coefficientMeasure O n
      (E ∩ residueCell O n (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_cells_partition
lean.docstring:
**Projective cell partition.** The primitive coefficient vectors of length `n + 1` are
partitioned into the projective cells of the divisors of degree `n`, each measurable with an
explicit mass, and the coefficient measure decomposes as a sum over cells.
lean.statement:
theorem projective_cells_partition (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∃ S : Finset (ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)), ∀ D, D ∈ S ↔ exceptionalDegree
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n) ∧ (∀ a : Fin (n+1) → O, primitive O a → ∃! D :
      ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O), exceptionalDegree
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n ∧ a ∈ projectiveCell O n
      (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) ∧
      (∀ D : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O), exceptionalDegree
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n → MeasurableSet
      (projectiveCell O n (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) ∧ coefficientMeasure O
      (n+1) (projectiveCell O n (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) =
      ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) *
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1) ∧ ∀ E : Set (Fin (n+1) → O),
      coefficientMeasure O (n+1) (E ∩ projectiveCell O n
      (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) = coefficientMeasure O (n+1)
      (projectiveCell O n (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) * cellMeasure O (n+1)
      (projectiveCell O n (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) E) ∧ ∀ S : Finset
      (ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)),
      (∀ D, D ∈ S ↔ exceptionalDegree (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n) → ∀ E : Set
      (Fin (n+1) → O), MeasurableSet E → coefficientMeasure O (n+1)
      (E ∩ {a : Fin (n+1) → O | primitive O a}) = ∑ D ∈ S, coefficientMeasure O (n+1)
      (E ∩ projectiveCell O n (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_cell_mass
lean.docstring:
A nonempty residue cell is measurable of mass `q^(-n)`, and its normalized cell measure is a
probability measure.
lean.statement:
theorem residue_cell_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (G : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hG : G.Monic) (hGn : G.natDegree = n) :
    MeasurableSet (residueCell O n G) ∧ coefficientMeasure O n (residueCell O n G) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n ∧ MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (cellMeasure O n (residueCell O n G))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_cell_conditional_density
lean.docstring:
The conditional density of a projective cell inside the primitive locus is the value of
`1 / projectiveNormalizer n` at `q`.
lean.statement:
theorem projective_cell_conditional_density (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    coefficientMeasure O (n+1) (projectiveCell O n v) /
        coefficientMeasure O (n+1) {a : Fin (n+1) → O | primitive O a} =
      densityValue (Expr.inv (projectiveNormalizer n)) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_cells_measure_preserving
lean.docstring:
Multiplying monic lifts of pairwise coprime monic residue polynomials `g i` pushes the product
of the normalized cell measures forward to the normalized cell measure of `∏ i, g i`.
lean.statement:
theorem factor_cells_measure_preserving (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (g : ι → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hg : ∀ i, (g i).Monic)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j))
    [hσ : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite
      (cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))] :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (factorProduct (fun i => (g i).natDegree))
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))))
      (cellMeasure O (∑ i, (g i).natDegree)
        (residueCell O (∑ i, (g i).natDegree) (∏ i, g i)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.form_cells_measure_preserving
lean.docstring:
The homogeneous analogue of `factor_cells_measure_preserving`: the reduced form product map
pushes the product of the normalized reduced form cell measures forward to the normalized reduced
form cell measure of the product form.
lean.statement:
theorem form_cells_measure_preserving (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1) (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1))
    (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1)
    [hσ : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite
      (cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))] :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))))
      (cellMeasure O (∑ i, d i) (reducedFormCell O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.block_descent_bijection
lean.docstring:
Frobenius descent: `selectBlock` is a bijection from the residue cell of `residuePoly Φ ^ r`
over `O` onto the block cell over `O[X]/(Φ)`, with inverse `descendBlock`; the selected monic
polynomial divides the lift of `monicPolyO a`.
lean.statement:
theorem block_descent_bijection (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    (r : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (selectBlock O Φ r) (residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r))
      (blockCell O Φ r) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r),
      descendBlock O Φ r (selectBlock O Φ r a) = a) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ blockCell O Φ r, selectBlock O Φ r (descendBlock O Φ r b) = b) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r),
      (monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a)).Monic ∧
        monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a) ∣ (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.descended_polynomial_type
lean.docstring:
Descent of polynomial types: if `F` over `Oδ` has type `σ` with pairwise coprime Frobenius
conjugates, and `G ∈ O[X]` maps to the conjugate product of `F`, then `G` has type
`scaleType δ σ` over `O`, where `δ = deg Φ`.
lean.statement:
theorem descended_polynomial_type (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (F : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (σ : FactorType)
    (hσ : HasPolynomialTypeF (AdjoinRoot Φ)
      (F.map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) σ)
    (hcop : ∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree ↦ (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) i)
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree ↦ (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) j)) (G : Polynomial O)
    (hG : G.map (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = conjugateProduct O Φ F) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O (G.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))) (scaleType Φ.natDegree σ)

array `m` has law `arrayLaw m`.

theorem monic_cell_law (hroot : RootCellLaw) (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (D : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
    (hD : AffineDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D) (m : Pattern n)

lean.docstring: The global law: average over residue divisors of the products of descended child laws.

noncomputable def globalLaw (projective : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Law :=
  lawScale (.inv (if projective then projectiveNormalizer n else .pow .var n))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr

theorem prod_formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr (ε : ℤ) (a n : ℕ) :
    SCongr n (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational
        (adamsSer m (clusterSer a))) (∑ K : Fin n → Fin n → Fin (n + 1),
        PowerSeries.C (scalar (∏ i : Fin n, ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (∑ r : Fin n, (K i r).val),
        ((availablePoints ε (i.val + 1)).rational - RatFunc.C (j : ℚ))) *
        RatFunc.C ((∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (K i r).val : ℕ) : ℚ))⁻¹)))) *
        (PowerSeries.C (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ r : Fin n, (adamsCoef (i.val + 1)
        (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (r.val + 1))))) ^ (K i r).val) *
        (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (∑ i : Fin n, (i.val + 1) * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) *

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_clusterSer_eq_coeff_qact
lean.docstring:
**Operator equation.** The cluster series is obtained from its Euler transform by the
Gaussian twist and the contact representation: `B_a = ρ(U_{a,a}) Φ(G_a)`, coefficientwise.
lean.statement:
theorem coeff_clusterSer_eq_coeff_qact (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (clusterSer a) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (qact (crossingQ a a) (gaussPhi (eulerSer 0 a)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_qact_crossingQ_gaussPhi_eulerSer
lean.docstring:
The `n`-th coefficient of `ρ(U_{a,a}) Φ(G_a)`, expanded by divisor degree `d` and crossing
depth `r` into crossing laws and pattern sums (plus `1` in degree `0`).
lean.statement:
theorem coeff_qact_crossingQ_gaussPhi_eulerSer (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (qact (crossingQ a a) (gaussPhi (eulerSer 0 a))) =
        (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        (if ((0 < r ↔ d < n) ∧ r ≤ d) then scalar (divisorProbability (State.single a n)
        d).rational * ((if r = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing a a r (n - d)))) *
        patternSum 0 a (a * n) (d - r)) else 0)) + (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_single_self_term
lean.role: self-return term q^{-tri n} q F
lean.docstring:
The self-pattern term of the recursion of `S(a;n)` (`n ≥ 2`) is
`q^{-tri n} · q · F_{S(a;n)}`.
lean.statement:
theorem lawCoef_single_self_term (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : TangentPattern (State.single a n).degree) (hP : Allowed (State.single a n) P)
    (hself : SelfPattern (State.single a n) P) :
    lawCoef (lawScale (.mul (tangentCount (State.single a n) P)
        (divisorProbability (State.single a n) P.d.val))
        (lawProd ((children (State.single a n) P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))) =
        qpow (-(tri n : ℤ)) * (qpow 1 * lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a n)))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingQ_eq_qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus
lean.docstring:
**Crossing factorization.** `U_{a,b} = U_{a+b,b}⁺ · J(P_{a+b}) · U_{a,a+b}⁻`, where `J` is the
diagonal substitution and `P_{a+b} = eulerSer (-1) (a+b)`.
lean.statement:
theorem crossingQ_eq_qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    crossingQ a b c h = qmul (qmul (qplus (crossingQ (a + b) b)) (qdiag (eulerSer (-1) (a + b))))
        (qminus (crossingQ a (a + b))) c h

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.monicExpr_two_eval
lean.docstring:
**Quadratic monic densities.** For every `q > 1`, the universal monic expressions of degree `2`
take the values `q / (2(q + 1))` (split and inert types) and `1 / (q + 1)` (ramified type), and
vanish on every other type.
lean.statement:
theorem monicExpr_two_eval (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
    (monicExpr 2 σ).eval q =
      (if σ = {(1,1), (1,1)} then q / (2 * (q + 1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(1,2)} then q / (2 * (q + 1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(2,1)} then 1 / (q + 1) else 0)

prove2me.blueprint_source: §1 table and §10.1

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.projectiveExpr_two_eval
lean.docstring:
**Quadratic projective densities.** For every `q > 1`, the universal projective expressions of
degree `2` take the values `1/2` (split), `(q² - q + 1) / (2(q² + q + 1))` (inert) and
`q / (q² + q + 1)` (ramified), and vanish on every other type.
lean.statement:
theorem projectiveExpr_two_eval (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
    (projectiveExpr 2 σ).eval q =
      (if σ = {(1,1), (1,1)} then 1 / 2 else 0) +
      (if σ = {(1,2)} then (q ^ 2 - q + 1) / (2 * (q ^ 2 + q + 1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(2,1)} then q / (q ^ 2 + q + 1) else 0)

prove2me.blueprint_source: §1 table and §10.1

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.single_two_law
lean.docstring:
The tangent-point patterns of `S(a;2)`: a transverse tangent with a node, a double point, a
point of contact two (a self pattern) and a point of degree two.
lean.statement:
theorem single_two_law (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (stateLaw (.single a 2)) σ = (if σ = {(2*a,1)} then q/(q+1) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(a,1),(a,1)} then 1/(2*(q+1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(a,2)} then 1/(2*(q+1)) else 0)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.projectiveDensity_two_ramified
lean.docstring:
Over any complete DVR with finite residue field of cardinality `q`, a random primitive binary
quadratic form is ramified (type `(2,1)`) with probability `q / (q² + q + 1)`.
lean.statement:
theorem projectiveDensity_two_ramified (htop : IsAdic (maximalIdeal O)) :
    projectiveDensity O 2 {(2,1)} = ENNReal.ofReal (Nat.card (ResidueField O) /
      ((Nat.card (ResidueField O)) ^ 2 + Nat.card (ResidueField O) + 1))

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul
lean.docstring: The twisted product E_{c,h} E_{d,k} = q^{-ck} E_{c+d,h+k}, as a finite convolution.

def qmul (U V : QSer) : QSer := fun c h ↦

    qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ))) * (U p.1 r.1 * V p.2 r.2)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingQ
lean.docstring: U_{a,b} = 1 + (q−1) Σ_{c,h ≥ 1} F_{T(a,b;c,h)} E_{c,h}; zero on the two axes.
lean.statement:
def crossingQ (a b : ℕ) : QSer := fun c h ↦
  if c = 0 ∧ h = 0 then 1
  else if 0 < c ∧ 0 < h then scalar (RatFunc.X - 1) * lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing a b c h))
  else 0

theorem qcongr_crossingQ_mul_qdagger (M : ℕ) (hS : ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a →
    SCongr M (eulerSer 0 a) (dilate (recipSer (clusterSer a)))) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * M + 1)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    QCongr j (qmul (crossingQ a b) (qdagger (crossingQ a b))) qone

theorem qcongr_qdiag_mul_qdagger (M s : ℕ)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.recip_main
lean.docstring:
**Theorem R (reciprocity).** For `n > 0` and every factorization type `σ`:
the universal monic density is the root-law coefficient with `q ↦ 1/q` substituted,
`A_{n,σ}(q) = B_{n,σ}(1/q)` (where `B_{n,σ}` is the coefficient of `σ` in the root law
`rootLaw n`), and the universal projective density is self-reciprocal,
`R_{n,σ}(1/q) = R_{n,σ}(q)`; both as identities of rational functions in `q`.

The certified form also assumed `ValidType σ` and `typeDegree σ = n`, which the proof does not use.
The hypothesis `0 < n` is used (`rootLaw 0` is defined separately).
lean.statement:
theorem recip_main (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (σ : FactorType) :
    (monicExpr n σ).rational =
      ((lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ).subst (.inv .var)).rational ∧
    (projectiveExpr n σ).rational =
      ((projectiveExpr n σ).subst (.inv .var)).rational

degree `2` take the values `1/2` (split), `(q² - q + 1) / (2(q² + q + 1))` (inert) and

      (if σ = {(1,2)} then (q ^ 2 - q + 1) / (2 * (q ^ 2 + q + 1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(2,1)} then q / (q ^ 2 + q + 1) else 0)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.actual_twisted_coker_reduction_bijective
lean.docstring:
In the stable range `d ≤ j + 1`, the map induced by reduction between the cokernels of the
twisted finite Čech differentials at levels `j + 1` and `j` is a bijection.
lean.statement:
theorem actual_twisted_coker_reduction_bijective (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ j + 1)
    (hnext : cechInputLattice R t x (j + 1) ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hnow : cechInputLattice R t x j ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hcomm : (cechOutputReduction R t x j).comp
        (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext) =
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow).comp (cechInputReduction R t x j)) :
    Function.Bijective (twoTermCokerMap (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow) (cechInputReduction R t x j)
      (cechOutputReduction R t x j) hcomm)

lean.name: SurfaceBlowup.surface_threads_range
lean.docstring:
For complete `R`, the image of `R` in Čech threads is the intersection of the kernels of the
levelwise twist-`0` Čech differentials.
lean.statement:
theorem surface_threads_range (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {t,x}) R] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (hpres : ∀ j : ℕ, cechInputLattice R t x j ≤ (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap
    (fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0)) :
    LinearMap.range (surfaceThreads R t x) = ⨅ j : ℕ, LinearMap.ker
      ((finiteCechDifferential R t x beta 0 j (hpres j)).comp (cechInputThreadLinear R t x j))
